description: This file defines the 'FeaturePropertiesDeleted' event class in the Eclipse Ditto project, representing an event emitted after a feature's properties are deleted on a 'Thing'. It includes constructors, factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality and string representation.
